answer: Charge each new agent identity a full stake, priced to the treasury's cost of forging one, releasing it only in slices earned by attested work. A farmer cloning thousands of keys must lock thousands of stakes for months, with just a pigment of credit peeling away as verified output lands. When clone votes cluster, slashing burns deposits, so expected profit falls below capital at risk; a karst of fake identity cannot build while the tide of real bonds rises, and honest work stays cheaper than faking a crowd.
